functions.name: decrement_stock
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.decrement_stock(row_id uuid, amount integer)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  UPDATE products
  SET stock = stock - amount
  WHERE id = row_id;
END;
$function$

functions.name: process_recipe_stock
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.process_recipe_stock(p_product_id uuid, p_quantity integer)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    UPDATE public.supplies
    SET current_stock = current_stock - (r.quantity_required * p_quantity)
    FROM public.product_recipes r
    WHERE supplies.id = r.supply_id
    AND r.product_id = p_product_id;
END;
$function$
